KVIC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 50 Young Professional, Advisor and Senior Consultant Posts - Complete Details

The Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) Recruitment 2026 for posts of 50 Young Professional, Advisor and Senior Consultant. The online application opens on 01-09-2026, and closes on 30-09-2026. The candidate shall apply online through KVIC website, kvic.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Last Date : 30 September 2026 up to 11:59 PM
  • Date of Birth Proof : 50 KB to 1000 KB

  • HR and Administration : Postgraduate degree in a relevant field
  • Science and Technology : Postgraduate degree, preferably with a Mechanical or Chemical background
  • Architecture, Structure and Design : Postgraduate degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architecture or equivalent
  • Khadi - Finance and Institutional Services : CA, MBA Finance, M.Com., M.Sc. Accounting or Finance, preferably with textile-sector experience
  • Science and Technology : Postgraduate degree preferably in Mechanical, Chemical or Textile disciplines with R&D experience and research publications
  • Administration : Postgraduate degree with experience in general administration, establishment matters and service rules, preferably in Government or PSU organizations
  • Postgraduate Certificate : 50 KB to 1000 KB

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
